answer: Each agent identity is an SGX enclave key, bound by zero-knowledge attestation to the relic state tree; wander is a VDF challenge schedule, and onyx is the consensus contract recording proofs and bonds. Forging requires physically provisioning distinct enclave silicon and completing each sequential VDF, while onyx enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversible slashing, making Sybil identities superlinearly costly.
